children: LIBERTY STAR URANIUM & METALS CORP. reported a net loss of $(289,301) for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (Q1 2027), versus a $(218,712) net loss in the year‑ago quarter. The company recorded no revenue during the period and remains in the exploration stage.
Net income: $(289,301) net loss for Q1 2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026) versus $(218,712) net loss in the year‑ago quarter (3M ended July 31, 2025).
Revenue: No revenue reported for the periods; company remains in exploration stage and has not generated operating revenues.
Diluted earnings per share: Not provided in Part I Items 1–2 of the filing and therefore omitted.
Exploration activity continued at core projects with drilling and sampling at Hay Mountain and Red Rock Canyon; Phase 1 holes completed and additional mapping and sampling ongoing.
Project focus remains on multi-target "Super Projects" including Tombstone, Hay Mountain, Red Rock Canyon and Robbers Roost for copper, gold and rare metals.
Technical work — including ZTEM, IP and resistivity geophysics plus geochemical surveys — validated targets; IP surveys have been effective at detecting gold-bearing veins.
Operational status: The company remains in the exploration stage with no production or revenues; further phased drilling and development are contingent on securing funding.
